parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight metal such as aluminum alloy. It is a slender, elongated part attached to the frame hinge.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or outward for storage or wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight metal such as aluminum alloy. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the wearer’s head, ensuring the glasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or outward for storage or wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lens Assembly)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame that holds the lenses and the bridge that rests on the nose. It is made of metal for durability and precision.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position for vision correction or protection and provides the structural foundation for the entire eyeglass assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the central support to which the legs are hinged.
